# Rooted in God's Love and Care

## Scripture

"For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future." - Jeremiah 29:11 (NIV)

## Reflection

As we navigate life's uncertainties and challenges, it's easy to wonder if God truly cares for us. His plan for our lives may not always make sense in the moment, but He promises to prosper us, not harm us. This promise is not limited to physical prosperity but extends to spiritual and emotional well-being as well. We can trust that God's plans are designed to give us hope and a future, even in the midst of difficulties. This hope is not based on our circumstances but on God's character and His love for us. As we seek to understand His plans, we must remember that His ways are higher than our own, and His timing is always perfect.

## Prayer

We thank you, Lord, for Your promise to prosper us and give us hope. Help us to trust in Your plans, even when they don't make sense to us. May our hope be rooted in Your character and love, not our circumstances.

## One-Line Application

We trust God's plans, despite life's uncertainties, to prosper us.
